parity_reason: Shape differs by 2 (4 vs 2) and clean by 2 (4 vs 2), and the totals differ by 11 (31 vs 20), so conditions 1 and 2 fail even though neither image has a critical defect.

reference.summary: A cheerful brown monkey clings to the trunk of a leafy apple tree full of red apples, with a sun, sky and grassy ground; it is clean and easy to read.

defects.what: The legs are drawn as thick round loops, so they look like rings more than bent limbs gripping the trunk
defects.where: the monkey's lower body and legs
defects.expected: The legs should read clearly as bent legs wrapped around the trunk, with knees and feet you can tell apart

defects.what: Hard to tell which loop is a leg and which is the tail, so the monkey seems to have one leg too few or too many
defects.where: the monkey's hips, legs and tail
defects.expected: Two legs and one tail should be easy to pick out on their own

defects.what: The raised hand above the head floats beside the trunk instead of clearly gripping it
defects.expected: Both hands should visibly grip the trunk or a branch as the monkey climbs

defects.what: The leg loops and tail cross over each other and the trunk edge, which looks a bit tangled
defects.where: the base of the trunk around the monkey's legs
defects.expected: The limbs and tail should overlap neatly so their outlines stay clear

attempt.summary: A small brown monkey on the trunk of an apple tree, with a caption reading 'A monkey climbing an apple tree'; the monkey's limbs are muddled and hard to read.

defects.what: The monkey's arms, ears and hands blend into one shapeless mass around the head, with dark balls for hands that look like extra ears
defects.where: the monkey's head and raised arms
defects.expected: Ears, arms and hands should be separate and recognisable, with the arms clearly reaching up the trunk

defects.what: The legs are thin sticks ending in dark ovals and blend into a stray line on the trunk, so you can't count the legs and tail
defects.where: the monkey's lower body and the trunk below it
defects.expected: Two clear legs gripping the trunk and one clearly visible tail

defects.what: Stray dark lines and blobs run down the trunk below the monkey and look like broken pieces
defects.where: the middle of the trunk under the monkey
defects.expected: The trunk should be clean, and only the monkey's own limbs should show on it

defects.what: A huge pale sun is cut off at the edge and fills much of the upper right, so it competes with the tree
defects.expected: A smaller sun that sits fully in the sky and stays in the background

defects.what: The monkey's hands and feet don't clearly hold the trunk; the feet sit as flat ovals on its surface
defects.expected: Hands and feet should visibly wrap around and grip the trunk
